resources.string: Share suspicious messages, links, or QR codes to ScamShield from any app.
1. In Messages/WhatsApp: Long press message → Share → 🛡️ ScamShield Quick Scan
2. In Browser: Tap Menu → Share → 🛡️ ScamShield Quick Scan
3. In Gallery: Open QR screenshot → Share → 🛡️ ScamShield Quick Scan
🔒 ScamShield processes content only when you explicitly share it. No background SMS surveillance or permissions required.
